arguments.body: Hi Luca, your landlord's annual gas safety check is legally due before 16 October. This is written notice that HeatRight Ltd (Gas Safe registered) will visit 19 Victoria Park Road on Tuesday 13 October between 9am and 1pm. It takes about an hour and someone needs to be home to let them in. If that doesn't suit, just reply with another time before 16 Oct and we'll rearrange. We won't enter without your agreement. Booking early keeps the same yearly renewal date, and you'll get a copy of the record within 28 days of the check. We'll be in touch again on Monday 12 October.
